package net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspaccountbuilder;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Dependency-free regression tests for the reference HUD state math and queue.
 * Stored as .java.txt so the Source Loader never treats test code as a plugin.
 */
public final class HudAndQueueRegressionTest
{
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean condition, String message)
    {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        check(Double.isNaN(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.levelProgress(12, 12, 12, false)), "bad XP bounds");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.levelProgress(500, 0, 1000, false) == 0.5, "level percent");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.levelProgress(-100, 0, 1000, false) == 0.0, "lower clamp");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.levelProgress(2000, 0, 1000, false) == 1.0, "upper clamp");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.levelProgress(2000, 0, 1000, true) == 1.0, "max skill level");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.hourlyXp(50, 5000) == 0, "initial unknown rate");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.hourlyXp(500, 3600000) == 500, "XP per hour");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.hourlyXp(Long.MAX_VALUE, 60000) == Long.MAX_VALUE,
                "overflow-safe XP rate");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.etaSeconds(0, 1) == 0, "completed ETA");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.etaSeconds(120, 0) == -1, "unknown ETA");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.etaSeconds(100, 120) == 3000, "ETA calculation");
        check(Double.isNaN(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.taskDurationProgress(30, 0)),
                "no fabricated task progress without a target");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.taskDurationProgress(0, 300) == 0.0,
                "new queued task starts empty");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.taskDurationProgress(90, 300) == 0.3,
                "queued duration progress");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.taskDurationProgress(300, 300) == 1.0,
                "completed queued task");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.taskDurationProgress(999, 300) == 1.0,
                "task progress clamps to target");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.taskDurationProgress(Long.MAX_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE) == 1.0,
                "task progress avoids overflow");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.scaledCoordinate(75, .75) == 100, "scaled hit coordinate");
        check(KspAccountBuilderHudMath.scaledCoordinate(75, 0) == -1, "invalid scale");
        check(KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.parse("").isEmpty(), "empty queue preserves auto mode");
        String queue = KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.append("", "WOODCUTTING", 300);
        queue = KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.append(queue, "MINING", 600);
        queue = KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.append(queue, "FISHING", 900);
        List<KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.Entry> parsed = KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.parse(queue);
        check(parsed.size() == 3, "queued tasks");
        check(parsed.get(0).durationSeconds == 300, "task duration");
        check(KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.move(queue, 2, -1).startsWith("WOODCUTTING:300,FISHING:900"),
                "reorder identity");
        check(KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.remove(queue, 1).equals("WOODCUTTING:300,FISHING:900"),
                "remove exactly selected task");
        check(KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.parse("INVALID:1000,WOODCUTTING:-2,MINING:300").size() == 1,
                "reject malformed queue entries");
        check(KspAccountBuilderTaskQueue.append(queue, "NOT_REAL", 300).equals(queue),
                "reject unknown tasks");
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checks + " Account Builder HUD/queue regression checks");
    }
}
